title: Cordless Tool Battery Charge Status
dataSources: Print jobs (`octoprint:job`), printer firmware telemetry (`printer:telemetry`), filament spools (`filament:spool`), CNC/laser jobs (`cnc:job`), workshop air (`workshop:air`), cordless tool batteries (`tool:battery`).
app: OctoPrint / Klipper (Moonraker) print servers, printer firmware telemetry, filament spool tracking, CNC/laser job logs, and workshop air/tool sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tool:battery
| stats latest(charge_pct) as charge, latest(state) as state by battery
| eval ready=if(charge>=80,"ready","charging")
| sort charge
description: Shows the charge level of your cordless tool batteries so you never start a job with a dead pack.
value: A flat battery mid-task is a familiar workshop frustration; a charge overview lets you grab a ready pack instead.
implementation: Ingest smart-charger status for your tool batteries; surface charge level and readiness for each.
visualization: Table of tool batteries with charge level and ready state.
grandmaExplanation: It shows how charged your power-tool batteries are, so you always grab one that is ready to go.
